# Provenance CI

> Provenance CI is an open-source Rust CLI and GitHub Action for local-first
> regression and continuity testing of C2PA Content Credentials across ordered
> JPEG publishing checkpoints.

Provenance CI reports the first observed interval between user-supplied
checkpoints where credential presence, cryptographic validation, trust,
declared continuity, or configured policy changes. It does not identify an
unobserved breaking component.

## Canonical documentation

- Overview: https://borborich.github.io/provenance-ci/
- Find the first observed C2PA break: https://borborich.github.io/provenance-ci/guides/find-c2pa-break/
- C2PA validation with GitHub Actions: https://borborich.github.io/provenance-ci/guides/github-actions/
- Validation dimensions: https://borborich.github.io/provenance-ci/concepts/validation-dimensions/
- Scope and limitations: https://borborich.github.io/provenance-ci/limitations/

## Source and release

- Repository: https://github.com/borborich/provenance-ci
- Immutable release: https://github.com/borborich/provenance-ci/releases/tag/v0.1.1
- GitHub Marketplace: https://github.com/marketplace/actions/provenance-ci-checkpoint-validator
- License: MIT OR Apache-2.0

## Current scope

- JPEG only
- Local paths and hardened public HTTPS checkpoints
- Official Content Authenticity Initiative C2PA Rust SDK behind an adapter
- Optional trust against an explicitly supplied local PEM snapshot
- Remote manifests and soft-binding recovery are not evaluated
- No hosted scanner, user accounts, asset upload, analytics, or telemetry

## Claims boundary

C2PA is provenance metadata, not a truth, copyright, authorship, AI-detection,
or manipulation oracle. Credential presence, cryptographic validation, trust,
continuity, and configured policy are separate dimensions. A changed file may
be a valid declared derivative. Provenance CI is not affiliated with or
endorsed by C2PA, the Content Authenticity Initiative, Adobe, or any vendor.
